bio: If the idea of a dining experience based around a traditional grill concept sounds appealing, this unusual, behind-closed-doors restaurant in the Palermo district will definitely fit the bill but you’ll need to book ahead! Here, everything revolves around two tasting menus: one 9-course option, and a second much more exclusive menu designed for just ten guests in a private space called the Chef's Counter and consisting of 14 courses (Provoleta cheese, Patagonian trout, chorizo, morcilla, pork belly, pine cone-smoked “ceja” and ribeye). The two informative menus involve lots of constant interaction and communication between the grill chefs and guests, the majority of whom are tourists or groups of friends.
